id: title:Gilbert09:add required region param to awin advertiser report

review.posthog_relevance: Adds region parameter support to Awin warehouse ingestion configuration and API requests, potentially preventing ingestion failures for accounts requiring region-specific endpoints.
review.reason: The change adds a region parameter to the Awin warehouse ingestion configuration and propagates it through the ingestion pipeline and API requests. This could prevent ingestion failures for accounts requiring region-specific reports. No tier assignment is performed here; this is an observation-only pass.
review.uncertainty: The benefit is contingent on the account requiring region-specific reports, which is not verified. The change could also be unnecessary for accounts not requiring region-specific reports.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No tier assignment is performed here; this is an observation-only pass.

observations.behavior: Adds region parameter to Awin API request and its configuration.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds region query parameter to Awin warehouse ingestion requests; without it, Awin's aggregated report endpoints return 400. This could prevent warehouse ingestion failures for accounts requiring region-specific reports.

observations.behavior: Adds region parameter to awin_source and get_rows function signatures and passes it downstream.
observations.posthog_connection: Propagates region configuration through warehouse ingestion pipeline, enabling the backend to supply region to Awin API calls.

observations.behavior: Adds region configuration and options to warehouse source settings.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows warehouse ingestion configuration to specify whether an endpoint requires region; this could prevent ingestion failures for accounts using region-dependent endpoints.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains only test and generated configuration changes. No implementation, schema, or connector behavior changes are supplied, so tier and benefit cannot be established.

observations.behavior: Adds a region field to Awin warehouse connector configuration and its tests.
